relationships.subject: Morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: CB2 receptors were expressed, predominantly, on NeuN-labeled cells with significant increases in CB2 receptor labeling across all surgery groups in both deep and superficial areas following morphine administration.

key_findings: CB2 receptors are expressed predominantly on neurons in rat spinal dorsal horn
Chronic morphine upregulates CB2 receptor labeling in deep and superficial dorsal horn
